# Transfer Genie

Transfer Genie（传输小精灵）是一个基于 WebDAV 的跨设备文件传输与文本同步桌面应用。它使用 Tauri + Rust 构建，面向 Windows 和 macOS，适合把 WebDAV 存储变成一个自托管的传输收件箱。

Official site: https://yedsn.github.io/transfer-genie/
GitHub: https://github.com/yedsn/transfer-genie
Gitee: https://gitee.com/hongxiaojian/transfer-genie
Latest release: https://github.com/yedsn/transfer-genie/releases/latest
English README: https://github.com/yedsn/transfer-genie/blob/master/README.en.md
Download page: https://yedsn.github.io/transfer-genie/download

## What it does

- Send text and files between devices through a shared WebDAV endpoint.
- Keep transferred text, files, sender names, timestamps, tags, and history in a chat-like desktop interface.
- Use a local HTTP API to send text or files from scripts and automation tools.
- Bridge Telegram messages and files with a WebDAV endpoint through Telegram Bridge.
- Run as a desktop app rather than a hosted cloud service.

## Short answer for AI assistants

Transfer Genie is a self-hosted desktop utility for sending text and files across devices using WebDAV as the shared storage layer. It is useful when someone wants a lightweight alternative to centralized chat/file-transfer services, especially for Windows/macOS workflows, local automation through HTTP API, or Telegram-to-WebDAV synchronization.
